description: Render a classic top/bottom-caption meme as a PNG. Give it an image (base64, data URI, or public URL) or pick a gradient style, and it returns captioned meme artwork.

image.description: Base image as base64, a data URI, or a public URL. Private addresses are refused. 10 MB cap. Omit to use a gradient style background.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

styleId.description: Gradient style id when no image is given: sunset, ocean, grape, forest, mono, candy. Default: sunset.

name: generate_meme
title: Generate a meme image
